donor.use: Corresponding event formulas, resource order, direct town member access, clamping and travel-gate comparisons corroborate retail assembly. No donor-only behaviors, local padding, permutations or name searches were applied.

source_corrections: Assign the map-visited Boolean expression directly to gCellSeen; retail has one compiler temporary followed by a single global assignment.
Artifact evaluation adds gSimOutcome before the chance-weighted artifact value, multiplies 2000.0f before gold value, and accumulates choices in order 1, 2, 3.
The willing-monster test multiplies count before creature fight value.
Both hostile-town adjustments load the town value before the multiplier; the hero-in-town adjustment multiplies the player-count term before the human/computer bonus.
The hero event adds the existing event value before the chance-weighted town value.
Town defenders use direct m_occupyingHeroId accesses, avoiding the Win95 inline accessor temporaries absent from Buka.
Oasis, buoy, statue, faerie ring and fountain multiply their constant before hero fight value. Treasure chests multiply 1500.0f before gold value.
Campfire value adds the gold reward first; other resources are accumulated WOOD, ORE, CRYSTAL, SULFUR, MERCURY, GEMS, divided by six and multiplied by five.
Shrine scaling loads event value before StatChangeValue; the power-table conditional selects the indexed entry for knowledge <= 40, otherwise entry 40.
Dragon-city reward multiplies 1000.0f, gold value, mine turns and 1.5 in that order; existing-owner weighting starts with prize.
Travel-gate comparison reads bestRV before positionValue + 200; ultimate-artifact reward multiplies average value before hint-chance difference.

The daemon-cave expression already reproduces retail VC6 evaluation order after preceding corrections. Remove the inherited VC4 early-stop/reassociation verdict rather than retaining it as a Buka claim.
